dish: Grilled steak with chips and salad

canonicalIngredients.name: beef steak
observations: 1.6-2.1 kg bone-in rib eye, shared board (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: olive oil
observations: 2 tbsp extra-virgin, split between chips and pan (s0)
50 g on steak + 100 g on potatoes (s2)

causalSequence: bring steaks to room temp; rub with oil, season salt and pepper
cut potatoes into chips; toss with oil, season
cook chips: oven 200C ~25 min until golden, or deep-fry 180C in batches
sear steaks on hot BBQ or pan, medium-high, 3-5 min per side to liking
toss salad leaves, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion; dress
salt chips while hot; plate steak, chips, salad; lemon wedge
techniqueFacts: all four sources rest the steak after cooking (5-10 min)
steak is oiled and seasoned before hitting the heat, not the pan (3 sources)
medium-high to high heat, 3-5 min per side gives medium-rare to medium (3 sources)
one source works to internal temps: 63C medium-rare, 70C medium; brings meat to room temp 20-40 min first
chip methods split: oven-bake 200C (s0), single deep-fry 180C (s1), double-fry 150C then 180C for crispness (s3), BBQ flat-plate rounds (s2)
one source soaks cut chips 30 min in cold water and dries them before frying
sebago named as the chip potato by two sources
chips salted while still hot (2 sources)
salad stays simple: leaves plus cherry tomatoes core, cucumber and red onion optional, dressed just before serving (2 sources)
sauce is an optional add-on, not core: chimichurri (s2), mustard creme fraiche pan sauce (s3)
